question: Which of the following plant tissue performs photosynthesis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorenchyma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chlorenchyma** is a type of parenchyma tissue in plants that contains chloroplasts, which are essential for the process of **photosynthesis**.
 
• This tissue is primarily found in the **mesophyll layer of leaves** and in green stems, where it plays a crucial role in **capturing sunlight** and synthesizing food.
 
• The chloroplasts in chlorenchyma cells contain **chlorophyll**, the pigment responsible for absorbing light energy and converting it into chemical energy.
 
• In addition to photosynthesis, chlorenchyma also contributes to **gaseous exchange** and stores the products of photosynthesis temporarily.
 
• Unlike other plant tissues like sclerenchyma, xylem, or phloem, chlorenchyma is a living tissue that remains metabolically active and supports the plant’s growth and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sclerenchyma:**

 
 
• Sclerenchyma is a type of plant tissue composed of dead cells with thickened, lignified walls.
 
• It provides **mechanical support** and rigidity to the plant but does not participate in photosynthesis.
 
• Examples include fibers and sclereids, which are found in hard parts of the plant, such as seed coats and nutshells.
 
 
 
• **Phloem:**
 
 
• Phloem is a vascular tissue responsible for the **transport of food** (mainly sucrose) in plants from the leaves to other parts of the plant.
 
• It consists of sieve elements, companion cells, phloem fibers, and phloem parenchyma.
 
• Although phloem is vital for the distribution of photosynthetic products, it does not perform photosynthesis itself.
 
 
 
• **Xylem:**
 
 
• Xylem is another vascular tissue that primarily functions in the **transport of water and minerals** from roots to leaves.
 
• It is composed of tracheids, vessels, xylem fibers, and xylem parenchyma.
 
• Similar to phloem, xylem does not carry out photosynthesis.
 
 
 
• **Parenchyma:**
 
 
• Parenchyma is a versatile plant tissue that performs various functions, such as storage, secretion, and photosynthesis (in the case of chlorenchyma).
 
• It is characterized by thin cell walls and large intercellular spaces, which allow efficient exchange of gases and nutrients.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Photosynthesis:**

 
 
• Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert light energy into chemical energy in the form of glucose.
 
• This process occurs in the chloroplasts, which contain the pigment **chlorophyll**.
 
• The general equation for photosynthesis is:

 Carbon dioxide + Water + Sunlight → Glucose + Oxygen
 
 
 
• **Chloroplast:**
 
 
• Chloroplasts are specialized organelles found in plant cells and some algae that are responsible for photosynthesis.
 
• They have a double membrane structure and contain **thylakoids**, where the light-dependent reactions occur, and the **stroma**, where the Calvin cycle takes place.
 
 
 
• **Role of Chlorenchyma in Plants:**
 
 
• Chlorenchyma not only aids in photosynthesis but also contributes to **gas exchange** and **water regulation** in leaves.
 
• It ensures that the plant has a steady supply of energy for growth, reproduction, and other physiological processes.
